text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And that time of year has arrived once 
more! The stage of the Chrysanthemum!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In the final race of the Triple Crown 
route, which Umamusume will bloom in full 
glory?!"

text_block_list.name: Excited Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"It's definitely Special Week! There's no 
way she's gonna lose!"

text_block_list.name: Restless Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh? You really think so~? I'm putting my 
money on Seiun Sky~."

text_block_list.name: Restless Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But I wonder which one will win! 
Hmm, based on the distance...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...The momentum has completely shifted 
toward those two. Even though they aren't 
the real main attractions."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I won't surrender victory on this 
stage.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Without fail, as a top-class umamusume, I 
will become the winner of this year's 
Classics.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll stay focused and see this 
through right to the very end.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Well then, it's about that time, isn't 
it? See you, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Let us meet in the winner's circle.
